sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ramesh Chandra Lal Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge-sheet dated 24.03.2022 and summoning/ cognizance order dated 19.05.2022 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 1388 of 2022 (State Vs. Omkar Singh and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 52 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406 IPC, Police Station Haldaur, District Bijnor, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Bijnor.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the court below and seek his bail and that his bail application be considered and disposed off in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 Sher Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145185298/
1 SCC 773.
Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.
